scope: Matched same-init environmental acoustic-view follow-up after all existing candidates reject. Recipe frozen before new model scores; final data index/completion identities bound only after full extraction audit.
model_choice: Quiet-bound8bit export frozen by numeric/fidelity only, not detector scores.6bit grid failed prespecifiedcosinegate and is rejected.
frontend: Exact512FFT window and257x32melmatrix,160samplehop,80dBfloor per1760sample block;8newframes per1280PCM/80ms. Native host versus source graph verified training-only.
data: Existing source/voice partitions; training+validation only.2normal-speed TTS variants: original quiet and room/gain/noise augmentation. Same human/environment source partitions, only training for fitting; no reserved testing read.
labels: Positive whole-phrase end uses existing synthesis/RMS metadata. Random head end .03.. .32seconds after label; reportendpointuncertainty. Negatives sample across all source windows.
head: Flatten16x96 -> Dense64 -> LayerNorm(epsilon1e-5) -> ReLU -> Dense64 -> LayerNorm(epsilon1e-5) -> ReLU -> Dense1 sigmoid
selection: Select highest macro recall on validation at <=.5 continuous false events/hour, tie lower FAR then lower confusing rate then earlier checkpoint. Retain strict/near-phrase diagnostics; freeze before existing paired/long regression. No reserved scores, no acceptance without physical/resource/voice-chain tests.
